content_addressing_shared_with.name: capacity-attest
content_addressing_shared_with.note: Same rail-neutral content-addressing (sha256 of canonical JSON of the content fields). Only signature recovery and address encoding are BSV-specific, isolated behind the rail adapter; capacity-attest's own verifyClaim is ETH/EIP-191-typed and cannot verify a base58 claim directly.

verifier.note: Recovers the signer from a compact Bitcoin Signed Message (BSM) signature: the public key is recovered from the signature and the claimId, then P2PKH(recovered) must equal buyerAddress. The carried buyerPubKey is cross-checked against the recovered key, not trusted.

settlement.chain_reference_note: BSV shares the bip122 genesis with the wider Bitcoin family; the settlement is disambiguated by the transaction existing on BSV mainnet (verify via a BSV explorer / WhatsOnChain).

asm_mapping.current_outcome_schema_limit: OutcomeReceipt v0.1-draft cannot type a non-fiat BSV settlement or external attestation reference without an extension mapping.

verified: raw claim bytes match the pinned digest
claim content recomputes to claimId (sha256 of canonical content)
the compact BSM signature recovers the signer and P2PKH(recovered pubkey) equals buyerAddress
BSV transaction is confirmed on mainnet
a P2PKH output pays payee and an input spends a previous output locked to payer
not_independently_proven: historical use of ASM for the paid call
